question: What does ALARM 29 mean on the Danfoss FC 202 and what should I check?
ground_truth: ALARM 29 (Heat Sink temp) means the maximum heat sink temperature was exceeded; it won't reset until the heat sink cools below a defined temperature. Check for ambient temperature too high, motor cable too long, incorrect airflow clearance above and below the drive, blocked airflow, a damaged heat sink fan or a dirty heat sink; also check the fan resistance, the soft charge fuses and the IGBT thermal sensor.
evidence: The temperature fault does not reset until the temperature drops below a defined heatsink temperature.

question: My Yaskawa GA500 shows GF. What is it and what causes it?
ground_truth: GF is a Ground Fault: a current short to ground of more than 50% of rated current on the drive output side. Causes are damaged motor insulation (from overheating), the motor cable shorting to ground, higher leakage from cable stray capacitance (lower the carrier frequency if the cable is over 100 m), or a drive hardware problem. Measure insulation and cable resistance to ground and repair or replace.
evidence: The drive detects this fault if a current short to ground was more than 50% of rated current on the output side of the drive.

question: How do I diagnose fault F08 on the Aquavar SOLO2?
ground_truth: F08 (8 blinks) is Open Lead: a disconnected or broken wire between the controller and the motor. Cycle power for 1 minute to verify; if it persists, turn power off for 5 minutes, remove the three motor wires and measure phase-to-phase resistance with an ohmmeter. A reading of 20 ohms or higher indicates the broken or disconnected wire.
evidence: A disconnected or broken wire will be indicated by a high resistance reading (20 ohms or higher).

question: What is Error 6 on the Goulds Aquavar (V120) controller and what should I do?
ground_truth: Error 6 is a Watchdog Error, one of the internal program errors (Error 1 to 8). Turn the unit off for at least 30 seconds and back on; if the error comes back, contact the Goulds Pumps Aquavar distributor with an exact description of the fault.

question: Water pressure on my Franklin SubDrive system keeps swinging up and down. What should I check?
ground_truth: That is the Pressure Fluctuations (poor regulation) condition with a flashing green light. Check pressure sensor placement and setting, pressure gauge placement, pressure tank size and pre-charge, leaks, and air being drawn into the pump intake (lack of submergence). Fixes: correct pressure and placement, a larger tank, set the pump deeper or install a flow sleeve, and flip DIP switch #4 if fluctuation is only on branches before the sensor.
evidence: Set deeper in the well or tank; install a flow sleeve with airtight seal around drop pipe and cable

question: My Yaskawa GA500 trips whenever it slows down a heavy, high-inertia load quickly. What is happening and what should I change?
ground_truth: That is an overvoltage (ov) trip: the deceleration time is too short, so too much regenerative energy flows back into the drive. Increase the deceleration times (C1-02, C1-04, C1-06 or C1-08), connect a dynamic braking option, or perform Deceleration Rate Tuning.
evidence: The deceleration time is too short and too much regenerative energy is flowing back into the drive.

question: The motor on my Danfoss FC 202 runs in the wrong direction. What should I check?
ground_truth: Check that parameter 4-10 Motor Speed Direction is programmed correctly, check whether a reversing command is programmed for a terminal in parameter group 5-1* Digital Inputs (deactivate it), and check for a wrong motor phase connection (see 5.5 Checking Motor Rotation).
evidence: Check that parameter 4-10 Motor Speed Direction is programmed correctly.

question: What does oL1 mean on the Yaskawa GA500, and when can it be reset?
ground_truth: oL1 is Motor Overload. Causes include too large a load, too-short accel/decel times, overload at low speed, L1-01 motor overload protection set incorrectly, or a V/f pattern that doesn't fit the motor. Reset oL1 only when U4-16 [Motor oL1 Level] is below 100.
evidence: Reset oL1 when U4-16 [Motor oL1 Level] < 100.

question: What does alarm 31 mean on the Danfoss FC 202?
ground_truth: ALARM 31 is Motor phase V missing: phase V between the frequency converter and the motor is missing. Remove power from the frequency converter and check motor phase V.
evidence: Motor phase V between the frequency converter and the motor is missing.

question: My Franklin SubDrive is flashing 2 times. What is the fault?
ground_truth: 2 flashes is Undervoltage, from low line voltage or misconnected input leads. Line voltage is below about 150 VAC (normal is 190 to 260 VAC). Check and tighten the incoming power connections and correct the incoming voltage (check the breaker or fuses, contact the power company).
evidence: Line voltage low, less than approximately 150 VAC (normal operating range = 190 to 260 VAC)

question: On the Yaskawa GA500, when does ov appear as an alarm (minor fault) instead of a fault?
ground_truth: ov shows as an alarm when the DC bus voltage is above the ov detection level while the drive is stopped (no Run command). The level is about 410 V for 200 V class drives and about 820 V for 400 V class drives. Causes include input surge voltages, the output cable or motor shorted to ground, too high supply voltage, or electrical interference.
evidence: The drive detects this error if the DC bus voltage is more than the ov detection level when the Run command has not been input (while the drive is stopped).

question: What is the rated output current of Aquavar controller part no. 0416-8371?
ground_truth: Part 04168371 is the 5 HP, three phase 460 V Aquavar controller; its rated output current is 9 A (15 A recommended circuit protection, 380-460 VAC ± 15% supply).

question: On the Aquavar SOLO2, how long can it take to auto-restart after an F04 over current fault, and what happens after three of them?
ground_truth: It can take up to 15 minutes (900 seconds) before the controller automatically tries to restart the motor. After three over current faults it stops trying and displays RSET; it must then be reset manually by turning power off for 1 minute.
evidence: It can take up to 15 minutes (900 seconds) for the controller to automatically attempt to restart the motor. ... If three overcurrent faults are detected the controller will no longer attempt to restart, at this time the controller will display RSET.

question: What does fault F10 mean on the Aquavar SOLO2?
ground_truth: The SOLO2 manual only lists fault codes F01 to F09; there is no F10, so the manuals don't say what it means.

question: What does 4 flashes mean on the Franklin Electric SubDrive?
ground_truth: The SubDrive fault table lists 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 and rapid flashes but no 4-flash fault, so the manual doesn't say what 4 flashes means.
